description: This dataset provides sediment radiometric dating measurements from a single geological event, LSMo22-1, collected on April 8, 2022. It contains detailed profiles of Lead-210 and Cesium-137 activities, including supported and unsupported fractions along with their standard deviations, measured at various sediment depths. The data is geographically anchored to coordinates near 21.37 degrees North and 104.57 degrees West at an elevation of 750 meters. Researchers can utilize this information to analyze sediment accumulation rates and chronological histories, making it valuable for geological and environmental studies focused on recent sedimentation processes and radiometric dating techniques.
